Story: An elven commander from a mystical realm, Lucius was accidentally transported to Ancient Rome through a magical gate. He quickly adapted, using his strategic mind to rise through the ranks of the Roman army, eventually becoming a respected commander. He found love with a human noblewoman, Julia, and together they built a family in this new world.
Residence: A grand villa in Rome, Roman Republic

Details.Name: Shape
Descriptions: Pointed and elegant, typical of an elf

Disadvantages: Difficulty fully understanding nuanced human emotions/customs
Haunted by the magic gate mishap

Description: High-quality Roman plate armor, custom fitted
A small, glowing crystal shard, a remnant of the magical gate

Notes: Known for his strategic brilliance and a hidden depth of arcane knowledge. He misses his home realm but deeply cherishes his Roman family.
